setup.title: Set up your pharmacy
setup.subtitle: Create your pharmacy and its first branch to start working. You can invite your team next.
setup.branchHint: Leave blank to use Main branch. You can add more branches later.
setup.countryHint: Optional two-letter country code, for example BJ or CA.
setup.currencyHint: Three-letter ISO code, for example XOF, XAF, CAD, USD or EUR. Default: XOF.
setup.timezoneHint: For example Africa/Porto-Novo or America/Toronto. Default: UTC.
setup.onlineRequired: Connect to the internet to create or update setup and team details.
setup.registerHint: Use the email address on your staff invitation, or your own email to set up a pharmacy. Use a password of at least 8 characters.
setup.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then return here and sign in.
setup.branchCreated: Branch created. Select it above to start working there.
setup.noBranches: No active branches yet. Create your first branch below.
setup.cachedBranches: Showing previously synchronized branches. Connect to refresh or create a branch.
setup.staffDescription: Invite your team and choose their roles and branches. Staff access becomes active after the invitation is accepted.
setup.inviteHint: Invitations appear in the app after the person registers and signs in with this verified email. Share the app link with them. PharmacyStock does not send an invitation email. Invitations expire after 7 days.
setup.shareInvitation: You are invited to {{pharmacy}} on PharmacyStock. Open {{url}}, create an account or sign in using the invited email address, confirm your email, then accept the invitation shown in the app.
setup.refreshFailed: Saved, but the pharmacy could not be reloaded. Connect and retry to load your saved setup.
setup.noInvitations: No pending invitations for your verified email. If you were invited, confirm the email matches and refresh. Pharmacy owners can create their pharmacy below.
setup.checklistHint: Follow these steps at your own pace. You can keep using the app while setup is in progress.
setup.checklistOffline: Connect to refresh setup progress. Saved records determine completion.

nav.description: All your pharmacy workspaces, including setup and purchasing.

errors.names: Enter a pharmacy name and a branch name, up to 160 characters each.
errors.country: Use a two-letter country code, for example BJ or CA.
errors.currency: Use a three-letter currency code, for example XOF or CAD.
errors.timezone: Enter a valid timezone, for example UTC or Africa/Porto-Novo.
errors.staffName: Enter the staff member's name, up to 160 characters.
errors.assignment: Choose a staff role and an active branch.
errors.password: Use a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.verifyEmail: Confirm your email address, then sign in again to continue.
errors.invitationUnavailable: This invitation is no longer available. Ask the pharmacy owner for a new invitation.
errors.alreadyMember: This account already has a pharmacy membership. Refresh to load its current access.
errors.invitationPending: A pending invitation already exists for this email with different details. Cancel it before inviting again.
errors.share: The share window could not open. Ask the staff member to open PharmacyStock and sign in with the invited email.
